description: Create a new branch from main and set up the environment for re-implementing PR #206 audit fixes. Install Python and Node dependencies, run existing tests to confirm baseline is green.
steps: Install Python dependencies: pip install from requirements.in (stripped hashes)
Install Node dependencies: corepack enable && pnpm install
Run backend linting: ruff check apps/backend/app/ (install ruff if needed)
Run edge typecheck: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
Confirm baseline is green before any changes
acceptance_criteria: New branch 'audit/implement-remaining-fixes-v2' exists and is checked out
findings: Pre-existing issues on main: (1) TypeScript error in apps/edge/src/middleware/bot.ts line 20 - 'data' is of type 'unknown' (TS18046). (2) Ruff F841 warnings in admin_content.py:632, admin_dashboard.py:31, content_publisher.py:73 - unused variables. Both are NOT caused by this branch and will be fixed in FEAT-002. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv, Node v22.22.3, pnpm 10.26.1 all confirmed working.
